title: Wrong translation of "time to eat" in German
body:
I would have fixed it and created a pull request - however, this seems to not be the way with crowdin.

The line
https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/796d36ef0df2a4e62a17188e1e459290f35c4eac/plugins/automation/src/main/res/values-de-rDE/strings.xml#L112

should be 

` <string name="time_to_eat">Zeit zu essen!\nFühre den Bolus-Assistenten aus, um die Berechnung erneut durchzuführen.</string>`

comments.body: You need to fix this in crowdin. Then it will be merged to dev and later master.
I updated it in crowdin. Can you validate / approve it?

I think you need to see in crowdin who is responsible for this. I for example approve Norwegian translations but I don't have access to other languages. If there is issues with getting things done in the German language I would contact one of the administrators at crowdin for AAPS.
